title: Todoom board
description: One board: boards/<id>/board.json. Missing fields get defaults; a field of the wrong type makes Todoom skip the board and its cards.

id.description: Also the folder name under boards/.

key.description: Prefix of the cards' short ids (SOL in SOL-42), unique among boards. Given automatically from the name when missing.

description.description: Context page of the board: repository, working rules, vocabulary, meaning of the columns. Agents read it before taking a ticket.

branchFormat.description: How the cards' git branches are named: {type} (feat or fix), {ref} (TOD-51), {key}, {number}, {slug} (the title). Default "{type}/{ref}-{slug}".

collapsed.description: Shown as a narrow strip; its cards stay in it.

limit.description: Most cards the column should hold; past it, the column is flagged.

archiveAfter.description: Cards that stayed this many days in the column are archived by the app (time from the cards' history).

priorities.description: Priority levels, highest first. When absent, the levels are P1, P2, P3 with ids p1, p2, p3.

order.description: Position in the sidebar, lowest first.

archivedAt.description: ISO date when the board went to the trash; null while in use. Trashed boards are hidden, and deleted with their cards 30 days later.
